description: Agent Insurance: submit a renewal with the expiring policy: the expiring policy with its number, the dates it took effect and ends, its currency, its premium and its material terms, each with its name and value as recorded; the renewal with its number, the dates it takes effect and expires, its currency, its premium, its material terms and the terms it records as changed, with premium for a premium change; optionally the notice periods recorded for a nonrenewal, a cancellation and a material change, in days; and each nonrenewal, cancellation or change notice with its id, kind, the date it was sent and the date it takes effect. The signed report gives the expiring policy, the renewal, continuity with the uncovered days or the overlap between the expiring policy’s end and the renewal’s start, every material term changed, added or removed with whether the renewal records it, the premium change in amount and percent with whether it is recorded, and every notice with the days it gave against the days required, and counts them, and names a renewal gap: a renewal that takes effect after the expiring policy ends, a nonrenewal or cancellation notice shorter than its recorded period, and a material term change the renewal does not record; then an unrecorded premium change, a renewal that overlaps the expiring policy, a change notice later than its period and premiums in two currencies, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No end or start date, no material terms on either side, no record of changes where terms or the premium changed, a premium missing on one side, no notice period for a notice or a notice with no dates leaves the renewal unverified. This reads one renewal against the expiring policy: a counterparty’s policy excerpt read as diligence evidence is wever_insurance-evidence-check, the notice deadline for an agreement’s automatic renewal is wever_renewal-notice-check and two versions of a terms text are wever_terms-change-check. Verdict insurance_renewal_gap, insurance_renewal_partial, insurance_renewal_unverified or insurance_renewal_continuous. POST /api/insurance-renewal-check. Reads the insurance records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment, claim filing, coverage binding or external write. Agent Insurance reads an insurance policy after the fact, from the subject’s own records: the coverage against the insured activity, the exclusions against the activity and its parts, the limits against the stated exposure, the deductible against what the buyer was told, the claims deadlines against an incident, a certificate against the policy it was issued from, incident notice under the policy and a renewal against the expiring policy. Beside it, wever_insurance-evidence-check reads a counterparty’s insurance certificate or policy excerpt as diligence evidence and reports what that material establishes against required coverages, limits and a work window, while an insurance check reads the subject’s own policy against a stated need, an incident or a certificate issued from it; wever_warranty-check reads a warranty claim against warranty terms, while an insurance check reads an insurance policy; and wever_risk-downside-check reads a planned action’s downside before it is taken, while an insurance check reads the policy behind it after the fact. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-insurance-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-insurance/.
